lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits. These primary spots are distributed along horizontal lines that coincide with the carinae, with approximately four distinct vertical columns of spots visible in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular white spots, forming anchor nodes that define a rectangular geometric pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin shows a distribution of high-luminance blobs, with approximately 5-7 distinct spots of varying sizes clustered towards the posterior trailing edge of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral edge of the left pectoral fin, appearing as a distinct, elongated silhouette with high-contrast leading edges.
